l5-fresh.label: IPL death-overs run rate with three or fewer wickets down after fifteen overs
l5-fresh.dataset: CricField warehouse: Cricsheet IPL ball-by-ball data, 2008–2026
l5-fresh.query: WITH st AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(CASE WHEN dm.dismissal_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) wk FROM deliveries d LEFT JOIN dismissals dm ON dm.delivery_id = d.delivery_id WHERE d.over_num < 15 GROUP BY d.innings_id), de AS (SELECT d.innings_id, SUM(d.total_runs) r, SUM(CASE WHEN (d.is_wide = 0 AND d.is_noball = 0) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) b FROM deliveries d WHERE d.over_num >= 15 GROUP BY d.innings_id) SELECT CASE WHEN st.wk <= 3 THEN '0–3 down' WHEN st.wk <= 5 THEN '4–5 down' ELSE '6+ down' END state, SUM(de.r) * 6.0 / SUM(de.b) rr, COUNT(*) n FROM st JOIN de ON de.innings_id = st.innings_id JOIN innings i ON i.innings_id = st.innings_id JOIN matches m ON m.match_id = i.match_id WHERE i.innings_number <= 2 AND CAST(CASE m.season_id WHEN '2007/08' THEN '2008' WHEN '2009/10' THEN '2010' WHEN '2020/21' THEN '2020' ELSE m.season_id END AS INTEGER) >= 2022 AND de.b >= 24 GROUP BY state
